## Requirements (from the contract)

1. The `<Figure>` component + contract — `value`/`artifact`/
   `pointer`/`definition`/`href` verbatim; `data-artifact`/
   `data-pointer` emitted; the visible "source" link per figure
   class.
2. The two build checks — manifest-listed-artifact enforcement +
   the named-page-class raw-numeral ban (home, dossier, coverage,
   freshness, sources, data, status); wired into the web
   build/check gate.
3. One `figures[]` registry per page; unique ids; each id
   resolves to a breakdown (UXR-34).
4. The coverage tiles rendered as Figures (K12b NEW-14);
   evaluation constants move into the release as a published
   artifact (`web/evaluation.json`) the figures point at.
5. The J3 §5.4 per-class link targets; absent routes render the
   named absence, never a dead link.
6. Tests: bypassed numeral fails; duplicate registry id fails;
   each figure class resolves its target shape; an absent-target
   figure renders its named absence.
7. Stamps: `SIG-TRANSP-013` (owner) + cited ids (SIG-UI-035,
   the J3 §5.4 per-class table, DR-C3-01/DR-C3-03, PKG-10) + F-102.

## Design reconciliation notes (recorded, not improvised)

- The J3 §5.4 per-class link-target table, verbatim:

  | figure class | link target |
  |---|---|
  | headline counts (home, coverage) | the definition page anchor + the release artifact (`coverage.json#/…`) + the downloadable file that recomputes it |
  | dossier counts ("7049 of 7049 … in GA") | `/r/<pub>/c/<comp>/jurisdiction/<j>/` record list + the dossier's page-specific provenance (per-source counts, PKG-10) + the per-source slices |
  | per-source counts | `/sources/<id>/` coverage section |
  | freshness / run metrics | the run row in `/sources/<id>/runs/` |
  | contradictions | the contradiction record(s) |
  | evaluation metrics | the published evaluation artifact (C3 DR-C3-03; today hard-coded TS constants must move into the release) |

- The per-class routes that no row has built yet carry the
  target *kind* as a named absence (recorded seam per the
  ticket's Interfaces clause): `/sources/<id>/` (P36.48),
  `/sources/<id>/runs/` (P36.46), contradiction record pages,
  and the `/r/<pub>/…` record list absent a bound release.
- `web/sources.json` + `web/evaluation.json` are new web
  artifacts (manifest-listed via the existing
  `_extended_manifest` path): the sources licence table is the
  artifact `/sources/` actually renders; the eval record is the
  DR-C3-03 move of the hard-coded constants into the release.
- "Raw numerals" are measured over the built `<main>` region
  (the layout's slot lives inside `<main id="main">` — the
  design's "main content"): a figure's own region (`sig-figure`
  markers), scripts/styles/tags, HTML entities, and
  reference-glued tokens (dates `2026-08-20`, versions
  `osm/1.0.0`, `§`/`#`/`RFC 9309.` citations, `%`/`:`-/`/`-
  joined ids, `…,503` prose lists) never count — commas only
  count inside strict `\d{3}` thousands groups. The remaining
  designed exemptions are recorded, never silent:
  `web/scripts/figure-numerals-allowlist.json` (file + token +
  count + reason — statute citations, HTTP status codes).

  - `web/src/lib/figures.ts` — the `FigureSpec`/`FigureTarget`

    `data-figure-id`/`-class`/`-artifact`/`-pointer`/`-breakdown`/

    the `<!-- sig-figure -->` region bounds the numeral check
    reads. `order` ∈ value-first/label-first/inline; `tag` is the
    wrapping element.
  - `web/src/lib/dossier-figures.ts` — the per-dossier registry:
    banner unknown-count, section figures + numeral-bearing rows
    (value OR note — the "…not 'currently shares with 147'"
    caveat case), notice-window days, numeral-bearing gap labels

  - `web/src/lib/figure-artifacts.json` — the committed manifest
    allow-list the fixtures-mode check verifies against.
  - `web/src/pages/artifact/[...path].json.ts` — the static
